/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
  active. -/
  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/

/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
are released. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
stops being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
`p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/

/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
  | .place _ => true
  | .frame _ => false

/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance

/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
`p`, transitively. -/
def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q

/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance

/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
        { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
released. -/
def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)

/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
usable. -/
def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying holders,
  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j
  /-- §70.3, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
    ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j
  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
  holders. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
    HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
      ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : ls ≠ []
  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
  element). -/
  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
  parent. -/
  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }

/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)

/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
one. -/
def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }

/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)

/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
  | none => hd

/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    List Place :=
  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
owning element of its parent. -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

(S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
    intro l hlt hleaf _
    exact ⟨l, init_usable hst (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by rwa [initP_len] at hlt),
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9: `cyc2` is reachable under a contract
with `DDSound` (§80), `transfer(0, 3)` from it is rejected because its destination would not be
usable, and the resulting state of that transfer, which violates `KInv` (§49.8, §54), is not
reachable (§57). -/
theorem reachable_cycle_rejected : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 cyc2 .reject ∧ ¬ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hdd, hr, -, -, -, -, hrej, hn⟩ := transfer_cycle_rejected
  exact ⟨hr, hrej, fun h => hn (reachable_kinv hdd (by decide) h)⟩

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False

/-- In every `ok` step, a leaf that becomes `Init` is written by the step (§59): a permitted write
(`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already
`Init`. -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : op.Writes s l := by
  cases op with
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (transferEff s src dst).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'
    split at hl'
    · rename_i hld
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlp⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hld
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs, hc⟩ := hpre.sameShape.2 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hlp
      have h1 := hpre.sameShape.1 r hr hrs
      rw [hc] at h1
      have hkr : kids s.P r = [] := by
        have : (kids s.P l).length = 0 := by rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hleaf]; rfl
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp only [OptP] at h1; omega)
      have hrf : r ∈ footprint s.P src :=
        mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
      exact ⟨hld, r, hrf, hc, hpre.srcInit r hrf⟩
    · split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (enterEff s ps ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | exit => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | write a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | writeShared a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | endUse p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (endUseEff s p).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ =>
      have e : (allocEff s ow ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
      rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    show l = p
    refine Decidable.byContradiction fun ne => hl ?_
    unfold storeEff at hl'
    split at hl'
    · simpa [ne] using hl'
    · exact hl'

/-- Every `Init` leaf of a state reached by a run from `S3.init statics` was declared `Init`
(§47) or was made `Init` by a write step of that run (§59): a step `t → t'` of the run, through
an operation writing the leaf, after which the run continues from `t'` to the final state. -/
theorem init_history {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : KStar k (S3.init statics) s) (hl : s.I l = .init) :
    (∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true) ∨
      ∃ (t t' : S3) (op : KernelOp), KStar k (S3.init statics) t ∧ op.Step k t (.ok t') ∧
        t.I l ≠ .init ∧ t'.I l = .init ∧ op.Writes t l ∧ KStar k t' s := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inl ((init_statics statics l).1 hl)
  | tail ht hst ih =>
    rename_i t u
    by_cases htl : t.I l = .init
    · rcases ih htl with hd | ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, h₀'⟩
      · exact .inl hd
      · exact .inr ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, .tail h₀' hst⟩
    · obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 hst
      exact .inr ⟨t, u, op, ht, hop, htl, hl, init_only_by_writes hop htl hl, .refl⟩

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5,
§76.6). §76.6 is read on the resulting state (v0.1 §76.6): its kernel component is `s`, since
`newArena` changes no kernel component (§76 `ok` effect, `newArena_kernel`), so `WF3`, `I1`,
`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are required of the whole kernel state `s`; the new entry is
the one `newArenaEff` registers, `available` holding the leaves of the storage and `issued`
empty, and it must satisfy `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True
  /-- §76.6: `WF3` (§49) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  wf3 : WF3 s
  /-- §76.6: `I1` (§50) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  i1 : I1 s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrder` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder s
  /-- §76.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) over the whole kernel state of the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld s
  /-- §76.6: the new entry satisfies `ArenaInv` (§55). -/
  arenaInv : ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True ∧
    WF3 s ∧ I1 s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧
    ArenaInv s ⟨storage, internal, footprint s.P storage, []⟩)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6 (read on the resulting state, v0.1 §76.6). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3 (v0.1): no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal` that covers a leaf of the administered storage. Dependencies of contained values are
covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`
  covering a leaf of the storage. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }

/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩

/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))

/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
      ResetD i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

/-! ## Helper lemmas (§40, §42, §43, §65) -/
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := hja
  have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
  exact no_desc_of_modify hy ya hly ha (allows_modify_iff.1 (hd.modeOK l hls))

/-- v0.1 §78.3, second sentence: under precondition 2 of §78 and invariant I3 (§52; a valid
anchor is an active one, §51), §78.3 holds. An anchor of a usable place is active (I3), so an
anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal` covering a leaf of the storage would be an
active derivative of `internal` covering that leaf, which §78.2 excludes. -/
theorem resetNoDeps_of_noCover {s : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} (h3 : I3 s)
    (h2 : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) : ResetNoDeps s E := by
  intro q _ hq x hx hix l hl hls
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ := h3 q hq x hx
  exact h2 x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hix ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l hl hls

/-- On states satisfying I3, the explicit check of §78.3 in `ResetD` never rejects after an
accepted `derive` of `internal` over the storage (v0.1 §78.3, second sentence;
`noCover_of_derive`, `resetNoDeps_of_noCover`): the derived `reset` is its kernel sequence. -/
theorem resetNoDeps_of_derive {s : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} (h3 : I3 s)
    (hd : DerivePre s E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify) : ResetNoDeps s E :=
  resetNoDeps_of_noCover h3 (noCover_of_derive hd)

/-- Under `WF3`, `I1`, `I2` and `ArenaInv` of a live entry, the preconditions of `reset` are
exactly the preconditions of `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage (§60) and the
explicit check of §78.3: §78.1 is §60.1 (`metaRight_iff`; the origin chain of the active `internal`
is active by I2, §51), §78.2 is §60.2 (effective `Modify` on every leaf of the storage), §60.3
follows from I1. -/
theorem resetPre_iff {s : S3} {E : ArenaEntry} (hw : WF3 s) (h1 : I1 s) (h2 : I2 s)
    (hai : Live s E → ArenaInv s E) :
    ResetPre s E ↔
      DerivePre s E.internal (footprint s.P E.storage) .modify ∧ ResetNoDeps s E := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have hA := hai hp.live
    have hsh := hA.shape
    obtain ⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩ := hp.live
    rw [hyi] at hsh
    have hli : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, l ∈ yi.footprint := fun l hl => by
      have := (hA.fpEq l).2 hl; simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using this
    have hmod : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify := by
      intro l hl
      have hd : descModes s E.internal l = [] := by
        apply nil_of_forall_not_mem; intro e he
        obtain ⟨j, y, hy, ya, hly, hj, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 he
        exact hp.noCover j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hj ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l
          (by simp [S3.afp, hy, hly]) hl
      rw [effective_eq hyi yia (hli l hl), hd]
      simp [effOf, hsh.1, Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
    refine ⟨⟨⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩, (metaRight_iff hA).1 hp.metaRight, h2.ancs_active ⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩,
      fun l hl => (mem_footprint.1 hl).elim fun h h' => ⟨h, h'.1⟩,
      fun l hl => (hA.fpEq l).2 hl, hmod, fun b _ => ?_, top_mem hw.frames.1⟩, hp.noDeps⟩
    unfold OptP; split
    · rename_i y hy
      rintro ya hb ⟨l, hl, hly⟩
      have hb1 : b ≠ E.internal := fun h => hb (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have hb2 : b ∉ s.ancs E.internal := fun h => hb (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
      obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := new_vs_old h1 hyi yia (hli l hl) (hmod l hl) hy ya hly hb1 hb2
      exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
    · trivial
  · rintro ⟨hd, h3⟩
    have hA := hai hd.active
    exact ⟨hd.active, (metaRight_iff hA).2 hd.exercisable, noCover_of_derive hd, h3⟩

/-- `reset` as its kernel sequence, per step (Part XIV, §78, §58): on a state satisfying the
kernel invariant, when the entry satisfies `ArenaInv` if live, the contract of `reset` and the
derived operation (`derive` then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3) have the same
outcomes, `ok` and `reject`, with the same arrival state, kernel part included (literal equality,
`resetKEff_eq`). On library-reachable states the hypotheses hold (`reset_as_kernel`). -/
theorem reset_as_kernel_of_inv {L : LState} {i : Nat} (hk : KInv L.kern)
    (hai : ∀ E, L.arenas[i]? = some E → Live L.kern E → ArenaInv L.kern E)
    (o : Outcome3 LState) : ResetC i L o ↔ ResetD i L o := by
  have hw := hk.1
  have h1 := hk.2.1.1.1
  have h2 := hk.2.1.1.2.1
  have h3 := hk.2.1.1.2.2.1
  have e : ∀ E, resetL L i E = ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff L.kern E.internal
      (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify) L.kern.A.length,
      L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩ := fun E => by
    rw [resetL, resetKEff_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | noEntry h0 => exact .noEntry h0
    | @reject E hE hn =>
      have hiff := resetPre_iff hw h1 h2 (hai E hE)
      by_cases hd : DerivePre L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify

theorem issue_keeps_init {k : K} {L L' : LState} {i : Nat} {region : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')) : ∀ l ∈ region, L'.kern.I l = L.kern.I l := by
  cases hs with
  | @ok E s₁ s₂ hE hst _ hsp hsto =>

    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsto

    have hne : l ≠ dst := fun h => hst.dstNotIn (h ▸ hl)

/-- Obligation of the encoding for a reference to `addr` with provenance `prov` (§82.3; Spec 11,
§81: address width and encodings are not fixed here): it decodes back to `addr` and every byte
carries the provenance `prov` (§10 ¶4). -/
def PtrEncAt (pe : PtrEnc) (addr : Nat) (prov : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  pe.decode (pe.enc addr prov) = addr ∧ ∀ i, (pe.enc addr prov i).2 = prov

/-- The allocation of the effective anchor of authority `a` (§44; §82.2: the provenance of a
reference to the region of `a`): the allocation of the root authority reached along its origin
chain, read on the first leaf of its footprint. -/
def anchorAlloc (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  (L ((s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a)).headD 0)).alloc

/-- Smallest value of `f` over a list, starting from `m` (§82.3; lowest-address rule). -/
def minOver (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → List Nat → Nat
  | m, [] => m
  | m, l :: ls => minOver f (min m (f l)) ls

/-- `minOver` is at most the start and at most `f` on the list (§82.3). -/
theorem minOver_le (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (m : Nat), minOver f m ls ≤ m ∧ ∀ l ∈ ls, minOver f m ls ≤ f l
  | [], m => ⟨Nat.le_refl m, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
  | l :: ls, m => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := minOver_le f ls (min m (f l))
    refine ⟨Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.min_le_left _ _), fun l' hl' => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl' with rfl | hl'
    · exact Nat.le_trans h1 (Nat.min_le_right _ _)
    · exact h2 l' hl'

/-- `minOver` is the start or a value of `f` on the list (§82.3). -/
theorem minOver_mem (f : Nat → Nat) :
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (m : Nat), minOver f m ls = m ∨ ∃ l ∈ ls, minOver f m ls = f l
  | [], m => .inl rfl
  | l :: ls, m => by
    simp only [minOver]
    rcases minOver_mem f ls (min m (f l)) with h | ⟨l', hl', h⟩
    · rw [h]
      rcases Nat.le_total m (f l) with hle | hle
      · exact .inl (Nat.min_eq_left hle)
      · exact .inr ⟨l, List.mem_cons_self .., Nat.min_eq_right hle⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨l', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl', h⟩

/-- Address of the reference to the region of authority `a` in `s2`: for a region whose leaves all
have zero physical size, the empty region included, the base of the allocation of the effective
anchor (§82.2, last sentence); otherwise the lowest address among the leaves of the region with a
nonzero size (lowest-address rule, recorded for §82.3). -/
def ptrAddr (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a : Nat) : Nat :=
  match (s3.afp a).filter (fun l => decide (0 < (L l).len)) with
  | l :: ls => minOver (leafAddr s2 L) (leafAddr s2 L l) ls
  | [] => baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)

/-- The raw operation realizing `store(authority, target)` (§82.2, §82.3, §65): one write into the
range of the leaf `target` of the reference to the region of the authority, with the address of
`ptrAddr` and the provenance of the allocation of its effective anchor (§82.2). -/
def storeOps {Ty : Type} (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : Machine.State) (L : Layout) (ty : Nat → Ty) (s3 : S3)
    (a p : Nat) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
  writeOps s2 L ty (fun _ => pe.enc (ptrAddr s2 L s3 a) (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) [p]

/-- The target of an `ok` `store` is a leaf of a usable place (§65.2). -/
theorem store_target {s3 : S3} {a p : Nat} (hpre : StorePre s3 a p) : LeafOfUsable s3 p :=
  ⟨p, List.mem_range.2 hpre.usable.lt, hpre.usable,
    mem_footprint.2 ⟨hpre.usable.lt, hpre.leaf, hpre.usable.lt, .inl rfl⟩⟩

/-- Realization of `store` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §82.3, §65, §16): under `Repr`, `WF3`, an `ok`
step of `store(authority, target)` and the parametric obligations of the write, the write of the
  have hlP := (hw.footprints a y hy l hl)
  have hin : l ∈ s3.afp (s3.effAnchor a) := (hfp l).2 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP.1, hlP.2, hlr⟩)
  have hh := (hfp _).1 (headD_mem (d := 0) hin)
  unfold anchorAlloc
  rw [hlw.alloc_part (mem_footprint.1 hh).2.2, hlw.alloc_part hlr]

/-- Pointer soundness of `store` (§82.2 pointer validity and its last sentence, §82.3 with the
lowest-address rule recorded for it): under `Repr`, `WF3`, `NoDangling`, an `ok` step of
`store(authority, target)` whose reference has the address `ad` (`ptrAddr`), the obligations of the
write, a target of pointer size (pointer-size rule, a stated hypothesis: types and ABI, §81) and the
obligation of the encoding for that reference, the range of `target` after the write decodes to
`ad` and carries the provenance of the allocation of the effective anchor. Every leaf of the region
lies in that allocation, which is live and contains the range of the leaf. For a region whose
leaves all have zero physical size, the empty region included, `ad` is the base of that allocation
(§82.2); otherwise `ad` is the address of a leaf of nonzero size of the region, the lowest among
them (lowest-address rule). -/
theorem pointer_sound_store {Ty : Type} {ty : Nat → Ty} {pe : PtrEnc} {L : Layout}
    {rtok : Nat → Nat}
    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a p ad : Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3)
    (hnd : NoDangling s3) (h : StoreStep a p s3 (.ok s3')) (had : ptrAddr s2 L s3 a = ad)
    (hsz : (L p).len = pe.size) (henc : PtrEncAt pe ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) :
    pe.decode (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p) = ad ∧
      (∀ i, i < (L p).len →
        (bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i).2 =
          some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).alloc = anchorAlloc L s3 a ∧
        AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ al.size) ∧
      ((∀ l ∈ s3.afp a, (L l).len = 0) → ad = baseOf s2 (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) ∧
      ((∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len) → ∃ l ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l).len ∧ ad = leafAddr s2 L l ∧
        ∀ l' ∈ s3.afp a, 0 < (L l').len → ad ≤ leafAddr s2 L l') := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨hpP, hpf, hpu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (store_target hpre)
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, -⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hpP hpf hpu
  have hrun : run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p) =
      s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) (pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a))) := by
    simp only [storeOps, had, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, run, opEff]
  have hbytes : ∀ i, i < (L p).len →
      bytesOf (run s2 (storeOps (Ty := Ty) pe s2 L ty s3 a p)) L p i =
      pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc L s3 a)) i := fun i hi => by
    rw [hrun]; exact bytesOf_write ⟨pa, hpa, trivial⟩ hi

/-- Under I1, two authorities grounding `HasRight s .modify q` coincide as soon as `q` has a leaf:
the ∃ g of §63.4/§69.2/§70.3 and a ∀ g reading pick the same g. -/
theorem grounds_unique {s : S3} {q g g' l : Nat} (h1 : I1 s) (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q)
    (hg : Grounds s .modify q g) (hg' : Grounds s .modify q g') : g = g' := by

  have e' := allows_modify_iff.1 (hg'.2.2 l hl)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hlx, hxm⟩ := effective_some e
  obtain ⟨x', hx', xa', hlx', hxm'⟩ := effective_some e'
  by_contra hne
  by_cases ha : g ∈ s.ancs g'
  · exact no_desc_of_modify hx' xa' hlx' ha e
  by_cases hb : g' ∈ s.ancs g
  · exact no_desc_of_modify hx xa hlx hb e'
  have := (h1 g g' x x' l hne hx hx' xa xa' hlx hlx' ha hb).1
  have hm : x.mode = .modify := by
    unfold effOf at hxm; split at hxm
    · cases hxm; rfl
    · split at hxm <;> cases hxm

import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-- Under I1, two authorities grounding `HasRight s .modify q` coincide as soon as `q` has a leaf:
the ∃ g of §63.4/§69.2/§70.3 and a ∀ g reading pick the same g. -/
theorem grounds_unique {s : S3} {q g g' l : Nat} (h1 : I1 s) (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q)
    (hg : Grounds s .modify q g) (hg' : Grounds s .modify q g') : g = g' := by
  have e := allows_modify_iff.1 (hg.2.2 l hl)
  have e' := allows_modify_iff.1 (hg'.2.2 l hl)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hlx, hxm⟩ := effective_some e
  obtain ⟨x', hx', xa', hlx', hxm'⟩ := effective_some e'
  by_contra hne
  by_cases ha : g ∈ s.ancs g'
  · exact no_desc_of_modify hx' xa' hlx' ha e
  by_cases hb : g' ∈ s.ancs g
  · exact no_desc_of_modify hx xa hlx hb e'
  have := (h1 g g' x x' l hne hx hx' xa xa' hlx hlx' ha hb).1
  have hm : x.mode = .modify := by
    unfold effOf at hxm; split at hxm
    · cases hxm; rfl
    · split at hxm <;> cases hxm
  rw [hm] at this; cases this

#print axioms grounds_unique
EOF

content.content:
inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))

/-- `OwnedIn P src q` (§40, §33): the ownership chain of `q` reaches a place owned by `src` or by
one of its parts, that is, `q` is storage owned, directly or transitively, by the value at
`src`. -/
inductive OwnedIn (P : List Place) (src : Nat) : Nat → Prop where
  | direct {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → partOf P o src →
      OwnedIn P src q
  | step {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o → OwnedIn P src o →
      OwnedIn P src q
